main_topics.reason: The user asked whether they would improve, returned to the timeline, and asked what persistent symptoms could mean.
The user discussed pacing, finding an energy limit, and tracking activity after food shopping led to prolonged crashes.
The user described being wiped out for days after an ordinary activity and asked whether those crashes could affect recovery.
The user said work and household demands limit opportunities to rest and that their manager does not understand the ongoing illness.
The user described a prior GP appointment as dismissive and asked how to make the next conversation more concrete.
The user said the uncertain timeline felt endless and that false reassurance made them feel more alone.

output.summary: The user wanted an honest account of whether long covid might improve, and described crashes lasting days after ordinary activity. The conversation covered pacing and tracking despite work and household constraints, as well as preparing for a GP discussion; the user said the exchange did not make them feel worse. They planned to try pacing and tracking and felt they had something concrete to raise with their GP.
